metadata.label: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 1 curriculum

ontario-science-g1-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 1 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess the importance of a healthy environment for living and non-living things, and the responsibilities of humans in contributing to a healthy environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the importance of a healthy environment for living and non-living things, and the responsibilities of humans in contributing to a healthy environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the basic needs and characteristics of living things, including humans
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the basic needs and characteristics of living things, including humans

standards.summaryText: assess uses of energy at home, at school, and in the community, and suggest ways to use energy responsibly
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess uses of energy at home, at school, and in the community, and suggest ways to use energy responsibly
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of how energy affects their lives, and that the Sun is the principal source of energy for Earth
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of how energy affects their lives, and that the Sun is the principal source of energy for Earth

standards.summaryText: assess the impact on people and the environment of everyday objects, including structures, and the materials they are made of
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impact on people and the environment of everyday objects, including structures, and the materials they are made of
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding that objects, including structures, have observable characteristics and are made from materials with specific properties that determine how they are used
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding that objects, including structures, have observable characteristics and are made from materials with specific properties that determine how they are used

standards.summaryText: assess the impact of daily and seasonal changes on living things, including humans
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impact of daily and seasonal changes on living things, including humans
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of daily and seasonal changes and of how living things respond to those changes
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of daily and seasonal changes and of how living things respond to those changes
